grh_2eb7b86926bb9fb1d473.title: The Ham That Cried Wolf
paragraphs: Michael Hammond, a citizen-band radio enthusiast known for outrageous stories, overhears men planning to kill Governor Charles Dawson shortly after his inauguration. Because Michael has spent years telling tales no one believes, the police initially dismiss his warning, forcing him to keep monitoring the conspirators himself. He uncovers their radio handles, timing and plan to enter the governor's office, then identifies one of the men by voice at the state capital. The authorities have quietly taken his information seriously and use him to help trap the conspirators before the assassination can occur. The governor cannot reveal the operation publicly while the wider conspiracy is still being investigated, but he deputizes Michael as a special agent for citizen-band communications. Back at his radio club, Michael finally proves at least part of his story by calling the governor directly on the air.
